text:
michelle: Quick question 1 charged airport EV parking on the Redwood corpcard at SFO (vendor shows as 'EVPARK SFO') for $18.50 USD but attendant said receipts are emailed and I didn't get one. Can I still expense this? cc @luke
luke: If it's on the corpcard we usually need an itemized receipt. Do you have a photo of the parking screen or a transaction screenshot from your bank app? Also confirm if it was business-related (client meeting)
michelle: I have the AMEX transaction screenshot and a photo of the parking paystation (no printed ticket). It was to get to a customer dinner across the bay. I can upload both.
hana: Finance: for parking we accept a screenshot plus trip context as backup if no merchant invoice. If corpcard we also need last4 card to match. Please add `XXXX-9876` in the expense notes.
michelle: Added notes and uploaded images to Expensify: https://expensify.com/report/abc123 (attached). Category set to 'Parking & Transit'.
expensify-bot: Expense received: Report abc123, total $18.50, status 'Submitted' 1 awaiting finance review.
luke: Two small flags: 1) foreign-currency conversion fee might be separate if charged by bank, 2) for corpcard we prefer merchant invoice but manager approval can waive. @sam can you approve manager exception?
sam: Approved for this trip given client meeting. michelle please add short justification: "client dinner follow-up, parking at SFO to meet ACME" in notes.
michelle: Done. Also noticed statement shows $18.50 but bank adds $1.05 FX fee. That FX fee is personal (bank added after) 1 should I claim the $1.05?
hana: Policy: incidental bank fees are not reimbursable. Reimburse the $18.50 only. We'll mark FX fee as non-reimbursable and close out. ETA reimbursement next payroll run (~10 business days).
michelle: Thanks all!
